answer: Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. The knoll detector writes each match to the jade queue, and the nadir checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. A submitter whose answers share 9 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 26% of its pending payouts meanwhile. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
